confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge, not checked against live listings. Restaurant and beer anchors are more reliable than hotel and hostel anchors, which vary more by area and season. Cocktail and wine are estimated from local price levels because direct knowledge is weaker. The FX rate was taken from search-result excerpts of rba.gov.au pages, not from a directly opened page.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional Southeast Asian basis, calibrated to the price level of mid-sized Cambodian and Mekong-region cities (for example Siem Reap, with Phnom Penh priced slightly higher for restaurants and hotels) and to general Southeast Asian capital-city pricing. USD is the everyday currency, so prices are treated as USD-denominated.
